snippet.title: 1851 Mission Pom-Bär Pom-Bear PC DOS 1440p 60fps
snippet.description:
Runplays are like movies, they're intended to show you all levels, dialogs and music, they don't show my skill. I upload games every day. 
If you want a perfectly smooth 60fps experience,  use Firefox as your browser. Others may lag

My PC is barely enough to make 32-bit quality videos and it desperetely needs an upgrade. So again I address people who still think that they are wasting their time on watching ads before and during my videos. You're my only hope to continue. Without you, I cannot make Playstation, Sega Saturn, Dreamcast and Nintendo 64 games without cracking sound and glitching graphics. And I hope to bring them to you already this year, so please start watching ads and also proceed to their pages after - don't let my project die. Sometimes I mention in the comments when there are copyright tracks in the video, so you can skip ads in it without thinking twice.

Pros:
- Usually much shorter than an ordinary longplay. I skip only boring side quests,
which don't affect the story. I don' t collect every thingamabob and don't search every crook and nanny.
- In speedruns they skip levels, dialogs, cutscenes. And a longplay's usually too long. My runplays are faster than longplays, but with all levels, important dialogs, music and cutscenes, apart from the above
- Cheats used for faster gameplay
- High quality video and audio, don't forget to use 1080 or 1440 mode
- On some devices there are fps drops in Chrome and Edge browsers, use Firefox instead
- If available, I play on Hard difficulty for best ending
- I play games every day
